skill.summary: Browse, search, and explore Art Blocks projects, collections, and collector portfolios using artblocks-mcp. Use when a user wants to find, filter, browse, or...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of discover-artblocks-projects skill.
- Browse, search, and filter Art Blocks projects by name, artist, vertical, chain, tag, floor price, and mintability.
- View live mints, upcoming drops, project details, artist portfolios, and collector wallet summaries.
- Includes tools to list available tags and get platform context.
- Supports both Art Blocks Flagship and Engine projects across multiple chains (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base).
